<!-- ============================================================
     ERPNext — Purchase Auditing Voucher Print Format
     Compatible with : ERPNext v13 / v14 / v15
     Templating      : Jinja2 (ERPNext standard)
     Layout          : Full table-based (no flex / no grid)
     Theme           : Minimal — Primary #00AEF7
     FIX             : Overflow, alignment, spacing all corrected
     ============================================================ -->

<style>
/* ── Reset ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
* { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

body, .print-format {
  font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #1a1a2e;
  background: #fff;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

:root {
  --primary:        #00AEF7;
  --primary-light:  #e8f7ff;
  --dark:           #1a1a2e;
  --mid:            #4a5568;
  --soft:           #718096;
  --border:         #e8ecf0;
  --bg-alt:         #f8fafc;
  --dr-color:       #1464a0;
  --cr-color:       #148040;
  --tds-color:      #806400;
  --warn-color:     #e05a3a;
}

/* ── Wrapper ── FIXED: overflow hidden, strict width ────────── */
.pav-wrap {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 900px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  background: #fff;
  overflow: hidden;        /* FIX: prevent content bleed */
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   HEADER
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.pav-header {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  border-top: 4px solid var(--primary);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  table-layout: fixed;     /* FIX: prevents header from expanding */
}

.pav-hd-left {
  padding: 22px 20px 18px 24px;
  vertical-align: top;
  width: 52%;
  word-break: break-word;
}

.pav-hd-right {
  padding: 22px 24px 18px 20px;
  vertical-align: top;
  text-align: right;
  width: 48%;
  word-break: break-word;
}

.pav-co-name {
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--dark);
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.pav-co-meta {
  font-size: 10.5px;
  color: var(--soft);
  line-height: 1.7;
}

.pav-eyebrow {
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 1.5px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--soft);
  margin-bottom: 3px;
}

.pav-title-line1 {
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  color: var(--soft);
  margin-bottom: 2px;
}

.pav-title-line2 {
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--primary);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  line-height: 1.1;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.pav-doc-ref {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--soft);
  margin-bottom: 2px;
}

.pav-doc-ref strong { color: var(--dark); }

.pav-pill {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-top: 6px;
  padding: 3px 11px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  font-size: 9.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.8px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.pav-pill-draft   { background: var(--bg-alt); color: var(--soft); border: 1px solid var(--border); }
.pav-pill-submit  { background: var(--primary-light); color: #0090d0; border: 1px solid rgba(0,174,247,0.3); }
.pav-pill-approve { background: #e8fff4; color: #148040; border: 1px solid rgba(20,128,64,0.3); }
.pav-pill-reject  { background: #fff0eb; color: #c0392b; border: 1px solid rgba(192,57,43,0.3); }
.pav-pill-cancel  { background: var(--bg-alt); color: var(--soft); border: 1px solid var(--border); }

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   IDENTITY BAND
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.pav-id-band {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  background: var(--primary-light);
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,174,247,0.2);
  table-layout: fixed;
}

.pav-id-band td {
  padding: 5px 24px;
  font-size: 9.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 1.2px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--soft);
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.pav-id-band td span {
  color: var(--mid);
  margin-left: 5px;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  font-weight: 500;
  text-transform: none;
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   STRIP  — FIX: removed per-cell whitespace:nowrap that caused
   overflow; use a single-row compact layout instead
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.pav-strip {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  background: var(--primary-light);
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,174,247,0.2);
  table-layout: fixed;     /* FIX: strict width distribution */
}

.pav-strip td {
  padding: 7px 8px;
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--mid);
  vertical-align: top;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.pav-strip td strong {
  color: var(--dark);
  font-weight: 700;
  display: block;
  font-size: 11px;
  margin-top: 1px;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.pav-strip .s-first { padding-left: 24px; }
.pav-strip .s-last  { text-align: right; padding-right: 24px; }

.pav-strip-div {
  width: 12px !important;
  color: rgba(0,174,247,0.4);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 300;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 7px 0 !important;
}

.pav-audit-pill {
  background: var(--primary);
  color: #fff;
  padding: 3px 10px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  font-size: 9.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.8px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   AUDIT CONTEXT  — FIX: use 24px side padding consistently
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.pav-ctx {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  table-layout: fixed;
}

.pav-ctx > tbody > tr > td {
  padding: 16px 16px;
  vertical-align: top;
  border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
  overflow: hidden;
  word-break: break-word;
}

.pav-ctx > tbody > tr > td:first-child { padding-left: 24px; }
.pav-ctx > tbody > tr > td:last-child  { border-right: none; padding-right: 24px; }

.pav-ctx-lbl {
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  color: var(--primary);
  margin-bottom: 5px;
  padding-bottom: 4px;
  border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--border);
}

.pav-ctx-primary {
  font-size: 12.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--dark);
  margin-bottom: 3px;
}

.pav-ctx-body {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--soft);
  line-height: 1.65;
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SECTION HEADING  — FIX: consistent 24px side padding
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.pav-sec-tbl {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
}

.pav-sec-tbl > tbody > tr > td {
  padding: 14px 24px 0;
}

.pav-sec-head {
  font-size: 9.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  color: var(--dark);
  padding: 5px 10px 5px 11px;
  background: var(--bg-alt);
  border-left: 3px solid var(--primary);
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   PAYABLES SUMMARY  — FIX: consistent padding
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.pav-payables-tbl {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
}

.pav-payables-tbl > tbody > tr > td {
  padding: 12px 24px 0;
}

.pav-payables-inner {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  table-layout: fixed;
}

.pav-payables-inner thead th {
  background: var(--dark);
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 9.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  text-align: left;
  border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.pav-payables-inner thead th:last-child { border-right: none; }
.pav-payables-inner thead th.r { text-align: right; }

.pav-payables-inner tbody td {
  padding: 8px 12px;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--mid);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  vertical-align: middle;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.pav-payables-inner tbody tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }
.pav-payables-inner tbody td.r {
  text-align: right;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.pav-row-open   td { background: var(--bg-alt); }
.pav-row-add    td { background: #fff; }
.pav-row-pay    td { background: #f5fff9; }
.pav-row-close  td { background: var(--dark); color: #fff !important; font-weight: 700 !important; }
.pav-row-close td.r { color: var(--primary) !important; font-size: 13px !important; }

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   LEDGER TABLE  — FIX: table-layout fixed, reduced columns,
   smaller font, controlled column widths that fit 900px
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.pav-ledger-tbl {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
}

.pav-ledger-tbl > tbody > tr > td {
  padding: 0 24px;         /* FIX: consistent side padding */
}

.pav-ledger {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  table-layout: fixed;     /* FIX: critical — prevents overflow */
}

/* FIX: Column widths that sum to 100% within 852px (900 - 48px padding) */
.pav-ledger col.c-no   { width: 30px; }
.pav-ledger col.c-date { width: 70px; }
.pav-ledger col.c-type { width: 70px; }
.pav-ledger col.c-vno  { width: 95px; }
.pav-ledger col.c-bill { width: 80px; }
.pav-ledger col.c-supp { width: 110px; }
.pav-ledger col.c-exp  { width: 85px; }
.pav-ledger col.c-pamt { width: 75px; }
.pav-ledger col.c-tds  { width: 60px; }
.pav-ledger col.c-dr   { width: 75px; }
.pav-ledger col.c-cr   { width: 75px; }
.pav-ledger col.c-bal  { width: 77px; }

.pav-ledger thead tr.pav-col-head th {
  background: var(--dark);
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.4px;
  padding: 8px 6px;
  text-align: left;
  border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.pav-ledger thead tr.pav-col-head th:last-child { border-right: none; }
.pav-ledger thead tr.pav-col-head th.r { text-align: right; }
.pav-ledger thead tr.pav-col-head th.c { text-align: center; }

.pav-ledger thead tr.pav-col-sub th {
  background: var(--bg-alt);
  color: var(--soft);
  font-size: 8.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 3px 6px;
  text-align: right;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.pav-ledger thead tr.pav-col-sub th:last-child { border-right: none; }
.pav-ledger thead tr.pav-col-sub th.l { text-align: left; }

.pav-ledger tbody tr { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
.pav-ledger tbody tr:nth-child(even) { background: var(--bg-alt); }

.pav-ledger tbody td {
  padding: 7px 6px;
  font-size: 10.5px;      /* FIX: reduced from 11.5 to fit columns */
  color: var(--mid);
  vertical-align: middle;
  border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;    /* FIX: prevent wrapping that breaks layout */
}

.pav-ledger tbody td:last-child { border-right: none; }
.pav-ledger tbody td.r { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.pav-ledger tbody td.c { text-align: center; }

/* Allow description cells to wrap */
.pav-ledger tbody td.allow-wrap {
  white-space: normal;
  overflow: visible;
}

.pav-sno {
  display: inline-block;
  min-width: 20px; height: 20px;
  line-height: 20px; text-align: center;
  background: var(--primary-light);
  border-radius: 3px;
  font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--primary);
}

.pav-vtype {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 1px 5px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: 700;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  max-width: 100%;
}

.vtype-pi   { background: var(--primary-light); color: #0090d0; }
.vtype-dn   { background: #fff0e8; color: #a04014; }
.vtype-pe   { background: #e8fff4; color: #148040; }
.vtype-jv   { background: #f4e8ff; color: #640080; }
.vtype-grn  { background: #e8fff0; color: #007040; }
.vtype-pr   { background: #fff8e8; color: #806400; }
.vtype-def  { background: var(--bg-alt); color: var(--soft); }

.pav-dr   { color: var(--dr-color); font-weight: 600; }
.pav-cr   { color: var(--cr-color); font-weight: 600; }
.pav-bal  { color: var(--dark); font-weight: 700; }
.pav-neg  { color: var(--warn-color); font-weight: 700; }
.pav-tds  { color: var(--tds-color); font-weight: 600; }
.muted-t  { color: var(--soft); }

.pav-empty td {
  text-align: center;
  padding: 24px !important;
  color: var(--soft);
  font-style: italic;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  white-space: normal;
}

/* Tfoot */
.pav-ledger tfoot tr.pav-subtotal td {
  padding: 7px 6px;
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  background: var(--bg-alt);
  border-top: 2px solid var(--dark);
  color: var(--dark);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.pav-ledger tfoot tr.pav-subtotal td.r { text-align: right; }

.pav-ledger tfoot tr.pav-grandtotal td {
  padding: 9px 6px;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 800;
  background: var(--dark);
  color: #fff;
  border-top: 2px solid var(--primary);
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.pav-ledger tfoot tr.pav-grandtotal td.r         { text-align: right; }
.pav-ledger tfoot tr.pav-grandtotal td.pav-dr-tot  { text-align: right; color: #7dcfff; }
.pav-ledger tfoot tr.pav-grandtotal td.pav-cr-tot  { text-align: right; color: #7dffb0; }
.pav-ledger tfoot tr.pav-grandtotal td.pav-bal-tot { text-align: right; color: var(--primary); font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 900; }
.pav-ledger tfoot tr.pav-grandtotal td.pav-tds-tot { text-align: right; color: #ffd97d; }

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SUMMARY CARDS  — FIX: consistent padding, table-layout fixed
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.pav-cards-tbl {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
}

.pav-cards-tbl > tbody > tr > td {
  padding: 12px 24px 0;   /* FIX: consistent */
}

.pav-cards-inner {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  table-layout: fixed;
}

.pav-cards-inner > tbody > tr > td {
  width: 16.66%;
  vertical-align: top;
  padding: 0 6px 0 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.pav-cards-inner > tbody > tr > td:last-child { padding-right: 0; }

.pav-card {
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 5px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  background: #fff;
  border-top: 3px solid var(--border);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.pav-card-purch { border-top-color: var(--primary); }
.pav-card-dr    { border-top-color: var(--dr-color); }
.pav-card-cr    { border-top-color: var(--cr-color); }
.pav-card-tds   { border-top-color: var(--tds-color); }
.pav-card-var   { border-top-color: var(--warn-color); }
.pav-card-bal   { border-top-color: var(--dark); }

.pav-card-lbl {
  font-size: 8.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.7px;
  color: var(--soft);
  margin-bottom: 5px;
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.pav-card-val {
  font-size: 12.5px;      /* FIX: reduced to prevent overflow */
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--dark);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  line-height: 1.2;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.pav-card-val.v-purch { color: var(--primary); }
.pav-card-val.v-dr    { color: var(--dr-color); }
.pav-card-val.v-cr    { color: var(--cr-color); }
.pav-card-val.v-tds   { color: var(--tds-color); }
.pav-card-val.v-var   { color: var(--warn-color); }

.pav-card-sub {
  font-size: 9px;
  color: #aab0be;
  margin-top: 3px;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   EXPENSE + VARIANCE TABLES  — FIX: consistent 24px padding
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.pav-sub-tbl {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
}

.pav-sub-tbl > tbody > tr > td {
  padding: 12px 24px 0;
}

.pav-inner-table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  table-layout: fixed;
}

.pav-inner-table thead th {
  background: var(--bg-alt);
  color: var(--soft);
  font-size: 9.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.4px;
  padding: 7px 10px;
  text-align: left;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.pav-inner-table thead th:last-child { border-right: none; }
.pav-inner-table thead th.r { text-align: right; }
.pav-inner-table thead th.c { text-align: center; }

.pav-inner-table tbody td {
  padding: 7px 10px;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  color: var(--mid);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.pav-inner-table tbody td:last-child { border-right: none; }
.pav-inner-table tbody tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }
.pav-inner-table tbody td.r { text-align: right; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.pav-inner-table tbody td.c { text-align: center; }

.pav-bar-bg {
  background: var(--border);
  border-radius: 20px;
  height: 5px;
  width: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin-top: 4px;
}

.pav-bar-fill {
  height: 5px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  background: var(--primary);
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   TWO-COL LOWER
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.pav-lower-tbl {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  table-layout: fixed;
}

.pav-lower-tbl > tbody > tr > td {
  padding: 12px 24px 0;
  vertical-align: top;
  width: 50%;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.pav-lower-tbl > tbody > tr > td + td {
  border-left: 1px solid var(--border);
}

.pav-box {
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 5px;
  background: var(--bg-alt);
  padding: 12px 14px;
}

.pav-box-title {
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  color: var(--primary);
  padding-bottom: 6px;
  border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--border);
  margin-bottom: 9px;
}

.pav-box-body {
  font-size: 11.5px;
  color: var(--mid);
  line-height: 1.65;
  word-break: break-word;
}

.pav-chk { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; table-layout: fixed; }
.pav-chk tr td {
  padding: 4.5px 0;
  font-size: 11px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  color: var(--mid);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.pav-chk tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }
.pav-chk .ck-label { color: var(--soft); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.pav-ok   { color: var(--cr-color); font-weight: 700; text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; width: 90px; }
.pav-warn { color: var(--tds-color); font-weight: 700; text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; width: 90px; }
.pav-err  { color: var(--warn-color); font-weight: 700; text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; width: 90px; }
.pav-na   { color: #aab0be; font-weight: 500; text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; width: 90px; }

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   CERTIFICATION
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.pav-cert-outer {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
}

.pav-cert-outer > tbody > tr > td {
  padding: 12px 24px 0;
}

          <span style="color:var(--soft);">Posting Date:</span> {{ frappe.format(doc.posting_date, {'fieldtype':'Date'}) }}<br>
          {% if doc.get('amended_from') %}
          <span style="color:var(--soft);">Amended From:</span> {{ doc.amended_from }}<br>
          {% endif %}
          <span style="color:var(--soft);">Doc Status:</span> 
          {%- if doc.docstatus == 0 %}Saved
          {%- elif doc.docstatus == 1 %}Submitted
          {%- elif doc.docstatus == 2 %}Cancelled

      </td>

      </td>

    </tr>
  </tbody>

          {% for e in doc.purchase_audit_entries %}

                'vtype-pi'  if vt in ('Purchase Invoice','PI') else
                'vtype-dn'  if vt in ('Debit Note','DN','Purchase Return') else
                'vtype-pe'  if vt in ('Payment Entry','Payment','PE') else
                'vtype-jv'  if vt in ('Journal Entry','JV') else

              {% if e.get('tds_amount') and e.tds_amount != 0 %}{{ frappe.format(e.tds_amount, {'fieldtype':'Currency','currency':doc.currency}) }}{% else %}<span class="muted-t">—</span>{% endif %}

          <td class="r pav-cr">{{ frappe.format(doc.get('total_credit') or 0, {'fieldtype':'Currency','currency':doc.currency}) }}</td>

        </tr>
        <tr class="pav-grandtotal">
          <td colspan="7" class="fw-8" style="letter-spacing:0.4px; text-transform:uppercase;">
            Grand Total <span style="font-size:9px; color:rgba(255,255,255,0.35); font-weight:400; text-transform:none;">({{ doc.currency }})</span>
          </td>
          <td class="r" style="color:#fff; font-weight:800;">{{ frappe.format(doc.get('total_purchase_amount') or 0, {'fieldtype':'Currency','currency':doc.currency}) }}</td>

        {%- set r1_exp = doc.get('total_purchase_amount') or 0 -%}
